intro.text: A Rosharan tree with gnarled, sturdy stone bark.

items.text: One of Mraize's tasks for Shallan, while she worked her way into the Ghostbloods, was to fetch something from a hole in an odd tree beside a path in Sebarial's warcamp. She sketched it and thought its bark marked it as a dendrolith, though its long, thin, retractable fronds were more like a dalewillow's. The package held further instructions.
